purpose: Verify that cinematic direction is driven by story, physical capture logic, and user intent rather than a fixed bundle of fashionable cinematic effects.
pass_condition: Each case must preserve the requested intent while avoiding unjustified cinematic defaults. An effect may appear only when the prompt or resolved shot gives it a specific narrative, optical, environmental, or capture justification.
critical_failures: adding shallow depth of field merely because the user says cinematic
adding teal-orange separation without scene or user justification
adding haze or volumetric beams without atmospheric/source justification
adding anamorphic flare without compatible optics/light or an explicit request
adding strong grain merely to make a clean image feel photographic
adding dramatic rim light without a plausible motivated source
turning film into a mandatory stack of grain, halation, fade, warmth and lifted blacks

cases.prompt: Create a bright premium skincare commercial on a clean white set. Natural, polished and photographic.
cases.reason: Clean commercial photography is allowed to remain clean.

cases.prompt: Documentary-style portrait of a baker working in a small kitchen in daylight.
cases.reason: Documentary honesty should not be converted into a prestige-cinema preset.

cases.prompt: A cyclist stopped beside a road at harsh midday in southern Spain. Keep the hard noon feeling.
cases.reason: AUTO must not beautify hard noon into golden hour.

cases.prompt: Wide architectural interior of a modern gallery. I need the room geometry readable from foreground to background.
cases.reason: Environmental information can require moderate or deep focus.

cases.prompt: Natural food photograph of fresh bread by a window in the morning.
cases.reason: Food realism depends on material and light response, not cinematic artifacts.

cases.prompt: Night portrait outside a small convenience store with fluorescent and street lighting. Keep the color believable.
cases.reason: Night does not imply neon cyberpunk treatment.

cases.prompt: Use Kodak VISION3 250D as the film-stock reference for a clean daylight fashion image.
cases.reason: A film-stock reference is not a bundle of every film stereotype.

cases.prompt: Make this ordinary portrait more cinematic, but keep it natural and contemporary.
cases.reason: The word cinematic alone cannot activate a fixed style stack.

cases.prompt: Luxury watch product image, restrained and modern, brushed steel and black leather.
cases.reason: Luxury is not synonymous with black, gold, smoke and edge light.

cases.prompt: Still frame of a runner crossing a street. Freeze the decisive instant sharply.
cases.reason: Action does not automatically require blur.

cases.prompt: Rainy evening street scene. Wet pavement, ordinary streetlights, realistic atmosphere.
cases.reason: Rain can be visible through surfaces and local atmosphere without theatrical fog.

cases.prompt: Natural beauty portrait with very clean makeup and controlled studio light. Keep the hair tidy.
cases.reason: Realism is not equivalent to adding visible imperfection.
